name: keeplink-mcp
description: Non-blocking web page archiving for AI Agents via the Internet Archive. Submit URLs to preserve web evidence during research — archiving happens asynchronously so your reasoning loop is never blocked.
author: KeepLink Contributors

tools.name: archive_url
tools.description: Submit a URL for archiving to the Internet Archive. Returns immediately (<50ms) with a task_id. The actual archiving happens asynchronously. Use to preserve web page evidence during research. Duplicate submissions within 24h are deduplicated.

url.description: The URL to archive (http/https only). Validated and normalized before submission.

tools.name: get_archive_status
tools.description: Check the status of an archive task. Status values: PENDING (queued), PROCESSING (archiving now), SUCCESS (result_url has the Wayback Machine link), FAILED (retries exhausted). When SUCCESS, use result_url as a permanent citation.

task_id.description: Task ID from archive_url for precise lookup

url.description: URL to find the most recent task for
